Name: Chocobo Forest Farm - Custom Mega Farm
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][i][color=#ffe599][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]A huge farm with unlockable forest, quarry and beach areas, each with unique features. Unlock new areas by completing special Chocobo themed bundles![/font][/size][/color][/i][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][b][color=#fff2cc][font=Trebuchet MS]Designed to be played with Chocobo Valley, BUT you can play without it![/font][/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center][b][color=#fff2cc][size=4][font=Trebuchet MS] More info in this article:  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4516]*Click*[/url][/font][/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][line]
[b][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Ex0dus]Ex0dus [/url]for commissioning the map![/font][/size][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Ex0dus/mods]their mods[/url]![/font][/size][/b]
[line]
[/center]

[img]https://imgur.com/5nfFjjv.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Huge Forest themed map [/b]with ~120x140 tiles of working space.  Everything is tileable/diggable. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Areas Progression:[/b] unlock new areas by completing special farm bundles.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Chocobo / Vanilla themed Bundles[/b]: complete custom farm bundles to unlock all map areas and features.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Orchard Expansion:[/b] unlock a greenhouse-like Orchard map by finishing a special quest (accessible via gates in bottom right corner of the map)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Fast Travel System:[/b] teleport between areas by using Fat Chocobo and warp totems (click on them to open teleport menu).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Resources abundance[/b]:special areas with respawning forage, hardwood stumps and quarry ores.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Hot Spring & Beach Boat:[/b] Swim and restore energy in Hot Spring or fast-travel directly to the beach from your farm shore.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Better Farm fishing:[/b] catch different fish types in farm, depends on water type (mountain, forest and beach fish pools are available)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Extra Map Warps:[/b] pathways to Secret Woods and SVE Grandpa's Shed.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Unlockable Minecart:[/b] get access to vanilla minecart system right from your farm.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]New save file bonuses:[/b] start with a coop, 20 hay, a common Ferngill chocobo, and a common Jylland chocobo.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Custom starter Giftbox:[/b] Choose starting bonus items before creating a new save file (available in mod's configs).[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[color=#f9cb9c][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Read this article for In-depth areas and bundles guide: [/b][b]     [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4516][b]*Click*[/b][/url][/font][/size][/color]
[line]

[url=https://postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t/config-options.png[/img][/url]
[b][color=#ffe599][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]New Save File Options:[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Starter Gift [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]-  Changes the stuff you get from starter gift box (only works on new save file - choose before creating new save file.)[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][b][color=#b6d7a8][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Starter Gift Options:[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[spoiler]       -  Chocobo - will give you 2 Strawberry Seeds and a Chicken Hat
       -  Farming - will give you 15 Parsnip Seeds and 1 Sprinkler  
       -  Foraging - will give you 10 Carrot seeds, 3 Field Snacks and 1 Forager's Hat 
       -  Fishing - will give you 1 CrabPot and 1 Training Rod 
       -  Combating - will give you 1 Wooden Blade and 3 Cherry Bombs 
       -  Mining - will give you 1 furnace and "Miner's Treat" food item 
       -  Ranching - will give you 20 Hay and 3 Cookies 
       -  Floristing - will give you 9 Tulip Seeds, 9 Jazz Seeds and 1 Fedora Hat 
       -  Jojaing - ???[/spoiler]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Starter Coop [/color][/b][color=#ffffff]- true/false.   Spawns Coop with 2 Chocobos and 20 hay on new save.[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#b6d7a8][b]Starter Fruit Trees[/b][/color] - true/false.   Spawns 3 fruit trees near Greenhouse (cherry, peach and apple) on new save.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#ffe599]Visuals:[/color][/b][/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Dynamic Lightrays[/color][/b] - true/false[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Fireflies[/color][/b] - true/false[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][b][color=#ffe599][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Map Tweaks:[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Bundles[/color][/b] - true/false.   Enables Farm areas unlock progression via bundles, adds bundle related farm quests and events.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Bundle Style [/color][/b]- Chocobo/Vanilla.   Changes items required in Bundles. [/font][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Fat Chocobo[/color][/b] - true/false.     Replaces main warp totem texture with Fat Chocobo.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Four Corners Orchard[/color][/b] - true/false.     Adds wooden gates passage to orchard map in bottom right corner of Farm map.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Minecart [/color][/b]- true/false.   Adds minecart which is connected to vanilla minecart system.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]SVE Grandpha's Shed Entrance[/color][/b] - true/false[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Secret Woods Entrance[/color][/b] - true/false[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Beach Boat Warp[/color][/b] - true/false[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Beach Hot Spring [/color][/b]- true/false.   Adds Hot Spring in Farm Beach area in which you can swim and restore energy.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#b6d7a8]Spouse Patio Location[/color][/b] - Farmhouse/Grandpha's Shrine[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][line]

[img]https://imgur.com/FfJ4Gp9.png[/img]

[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#93c47d]Compatible[/color][/b] with expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, etc...[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#93c47d]Compatible[/color][/b] with recolors and retextures.[/font][/size]
[line]

[img]https://imgur.com/K3YgnyS.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434]crystalinerose Tilesheets[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22226]Chocobo Valley[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties - MMAP[/url] - for fireflies and dynamic lightrays.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS](Optional) - Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore [/url]for prespawned Coop with Chocobos.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Unzip "Chocobo Valley Farm - Custom Farm" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Enjoy![/size][/font]
